rationale: All feasible runs are setup-limited at ss/100C/max-RC by a port path (reg-to-reg only 3.9-4.4 ns); hold (+0.1 ns), slew/cap (0, bar 0) and final DRC are clean. T_eff ≈ 0.2×target + d, so period_frac stays 0.45. Timing-driven placement gives d 3.85-4.40 vs 5.2-6.0 without. Round 1 brought no gain: d 4.40 with the longest wires (4,940 um, 3.9% detour, 5 DRC iterations) plus one flow failure. The best d (3.85, bm64) came from DELAY 3, util 21, density +14, slew 30 and post-GRT design repair, with post-GRT timing off; pin that core at 0.45 (unpinning post-GRT timing, present in the failure) and let TPE vary sizing, buffering, RC model, margins and cap target.
